arena.name: Arena
arena.desc: 5 waves W/G, W/G, G/B, B/P, P/Y boss; Bloodaxe orc host; daily; 18-50 coins + gear; more common in oceans

wizard-tower.name: Wizard / Magic Tower
wizard-tower.desc: ≤5 per land; boss necromancer/wizard/sorcerer guards Magic Crystal at top; all crystals destroyed → land's Magic Barriers drop permanently

magic-barrier.name: Magic Barrier
magic-barrier.desc: blueish transparent wall sealing areas until towers cleared; overlapping-dungeon fix 0.9.3-0

circle-of-power.name: Circle of Power
circle-of-power.desc: henge of spire rocks; restless warrior (5★) + lore tablet; eternal ember → brazier → land buff; several per land

demon-portal.name: Demon Portal / Altar
demon-portal.desc: dark cultists channel beam to heal it; imps spawn endlessly; possesses NPCs land-wide until destroyed; big portals at altar centre (0.9.3-0); sizes vary

mana-pump.name: Mana Pump
mana-pump.desc: Steel Empire: 4 mana generators each with a boss (1-3 coins) → Mana Mech + pilot → smash pump; removes mana-absorption debuff

mana-inductor.name: Mana Inductor
mana-inductor.desc: smaller pump variant without mech; may appear at mana trees

mana-tree.name: Mana Tree
mana-tree.desc: kill surrounding enemies to summon boss; druids of mana; replaces alpha giant tree

shrine-of-life.name: Shrine of Life
shrine-of-life.map: white cube with door / blue dot when active
shrine-of-life.desc: angel holding purple cube; activate with flute (E) → respawn point + free fast travel between shrines

portal.name: Portal (teleport rune stone)
portal.desc: press R → map → click another discovered portal

bird-statue.name: Bird (eagle) statue
bird-statue.desc: small bird structure surrounded by pillars; play sky whistle → birds lift you to sky island

old-hut.name: Old Hut
old-hut.desc: witch boss petrifies a whole village; often spawns on roof (bug)

hidden-treasure.name: Hidden treasure
hidden-treasure.desc: treasure spirit points at it; counter per land

loot-tower.name: Loot / golden tower, crypt, tomb, graveyard

captive-site.name: Captive site
captive-site.desc: gnome supplier cage (boss key) or captured NPC

airship.name: Steel Empire airship
airship.desc: spawn vehicle overhead; paratroopers; cannot land on it; shows on title screen if you quit during event

wollays-house.name: Wollay's House
wollays-house.desc: block (0,0); Wollay & Pixxie NPCs; ≈1.1M coins flight from typical spawn
